title: The Blaschka Object Network — Workshop Logistics Document Register
scope: Document-level logistics, customs, invoice, packing and shipping sources explicitly listed in Series 04, Business Files, of the Leopold and Rudolf Blaschka Collection at the Rakow Research Library. This register turns the workshop archive from a repository-level citation into a retrieval list for circulation research.

source.repository: Juliette K. and Leonard S. Rakow Research Library, Corning Museum of Glass
source.collection: Leopold and Rudolf Blaschka Collection, circa 1730–1981
source.series_scope: The finding aid describes Series 04 as financial records, shipping documentation and ephemera. Shipping documentation mainly concerns botanical-model shipments to Harvard and extends through Rudolf's final 1936 shipment.
source.container_guard: The public PDF text extraction separates container strings from titles in a way that makes several item-to-container mappings ambiguous. This register therefore records exact titles and dates from the finding aid without silently assigning a box/folder unless the mapping is independently verified.

research_observation: The workshop archive itself already contains the documentary genres required for a history of circulation: waybill, customs receipt, consular certificate, invoice, contents list, delivery book and crate sketch. These sources should be read as an integrated logistics dossier rather than as miscellaneous business ephemera.
